info.title: Space API
info.description:
Build your own client for Space.

Create a personal API key in **Settings → API keys** and send it on every request as
`Authorization: Bearer spk_...`. A key acts as you in the one Space it was created for,
with your current role there. A read-only key can read and search; a read-write key can
also create, change and delete content. Keys cannot manage agents, keys, members,
restores or webhooks, and they do not work on the MCP endpoint.

Errors are JSON objects with an `error` message. Writes take an `expected_revision` or a
`command_id` where shown, so a retry never applies twice. Treat a key like a password:
keep it out of public web pages and revoke it in Settings if it leaks.

RememberMemory.title: RememberMemory
RememberMemory.description:
Write durable memory directly, without a source document or human review.

Parameters: free text the agent wants to keep, optional topic labels and an
optional originating resource revision.
What it does: organizes, embeds and saves the supplied wording without generation.
Long text is split losslessly into claims of at most 2,000 characters. On the
explicit extraction-job endpoint, the same input is mined into generated claims.
Output: the saved memory resource. Explicit links name existing memory nodes by ID,
with relation related or expands_on; they need no model approval. Retries reuse command ID.
